Results.ReviewText: I am 80 years old and I have always owned a Weber grill, propane, charcoal, and smoker. This is absolutely the best and I smile every time I push that ignition button. This Spirit 210 is perfect for my wife and me. When I had a Genesis I had 3 kids and cooked out several times a week year round. Nothing but happy, pleasant memories and terrific meals! I would certainly recommend Weber to any and all family oriented chefs.
Results.Title: How to impress and solidify your family

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my Weber Grill about 5 years ago and have been very pleased with my purchase. I have had several other brands. But they were inferior and didn’t hold up. The Weber cook’s great. An when a couple of my parts wore out. They were promptly replaced under the warranty, no problem.
Results.Title: Best grill ever

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us and is a very important part of our process. We are very sorry to hear about your experience with the leak at the hose and regulator. Most cases of leaks in this area are a result of a bad propane tank gasket. Our Care team will reach out to follow up. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased a new Weber grill last Sun=day (April 14, 2024)There is a gas leak at the cylinder that connects to the propane tank and it is entirely too difficult to contact you regarding replacement of the part at no cost to me.  Since I registered my grill, I would expect that repairs would not cost me anything.  When I was unable to find anyone with Weber, I contacted the retailer, who advised me that I could return the grille to the store, but since we had to assemble it, I am loathe to do that, My husband has no interest in assembling a new replacement grille.  This is the third Weber I have owned and it is the first time we have had to assemble it, and we do not want to repeat that experience  We did not know the cylinder was defective until we heard gas escaping when we go ready to use it; the cylinder was already installed on the body of the grille.
Results.Title: Problem with part leaking gas

Results.ReviewText: The first e-210 was defective.  The front frame was out of square causing the door to sit crooked in the frame.  Weber was unable to determine the cause and was willing to ship out hundreds of dollars worth of parts to try to fix it, but that seemed wrong.  Wilmes Hardware where I purchased the grill picked up the defective on and brought me a new one at no charge.
Results.Title: Great grill, but out of square frame.

Results.ReviewText: Love my grill. Easy to use, clean and so easy to use!!!!
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText: I would give this grill 5 stars if Weber sold stainless steel grates for this model.  The only drawback for me is the cleaning of the porcelain cast grates.  Stainless would be much easier to clean.  I've had this grill for over 15 years and it still works beautifully.  Its small size is appropriate for our family and fits in a nook on our deck.  The local business that sold this to me has given me good service over the years.

I bought because of build quality, warranty, and performance.  Weber delivers on all. Sure you pay more but you get so much more. I have had cheaper grills in the past but after 5 years they needed to be replaced. I have no doubts that this grill will last easily 10 years and more. I bought the E210 because of the size. I live in a condo and it was the best option for my balcony.
Results.Title: Build quality,  performane, and warranty.

Results.ReviewText: I bought my Spirit 210 five years ago, and it still works fantastic! The only thing I have had to replace is the heat shields, a normal wear item. I highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Great Quality and Performance!!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second E-210. I used the first one until the wheels actually fell off. It's the perfect small size for just me and big enough to hold a lot more food when i have company.  Grill temperature is good and adjusts quickly if needed.
Results.Title: Perfect grill for small and large meals.

Results.ReviewText: Best Grill I’ve had! Love the temp control. Heavy duty and very sturdy. Propane indicator is very handy. Easy to clean.
Results.Title: Best Grill I’ve had!

Results.ReviewText: Another great product from Weber. My first gas grill and I kept my Kettle that is over 30 years old. Finally replaced the bottom grate. Nice to have a choice or use both for parties.
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever

Results.ReviewText: I have used it three times so far and steaks and burgers have been great
Results.Title: Happy guy

Results.ReviewText: i actually won this grill ,but it replaced my weber gas grille that was 5 years old and still in great shape so i gave it to my daughter, she should get another 5 out of it, its the only grill that will hold up
Results.Title: loves my weber

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased the Weber Spirit E-210. I really enjoy using this grill. I like that it is the right size for my grilling. The sides fold and the propane tank is hidden. I also can lock the wheels from moving. This product is so great. By the way,my former grill was the Weber Spirit E-210.
Results.Title: Grill Master

Results.ReviewText: This is our 2nd Weber and we love it. They last and grill great.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: Best grill! It’s our first Weber and it hasn’t disappointed yet.
Results.Title: First Weber

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are so sorry to hear about your wheels rotting out. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Our Care team is here to help. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The wheels rotted out before the warranty. Replacing the wheels have been a nightmare and who wants to spend money on the same wheels that will rot out in less than 5 years. Igniter is in poor location, it is hit with tank with installation of tank every time, gave up in replacing it.
Results.Title: Inferior parts

Results.ReviewText: Cooks food Hotter and Faster then any grill I've had
Results.Title: Cooks food fast and hot

Results.ReviewText: Grill works fine.  2 things:  (1)  Even though I use your grill cover there are beginnings of rust streaks on the 2 side arms. Your Customer Service rep sent me (gratis) your stainless steel polish which didn't cover/move any of it.  (2)  Not having a man on the premises it wasa impossible to lift the propane container on your gauge.  Surprise!
Results.Title: Cheap stainless steel.

Results.ReviewText: Sturdy and well built.  Have only grilled a few times since we got it, but the food has been good. Have to be sure not to overcook and dry out the food.  One complaint is that when you buy a grill that is this expensive, it should come with a grill cover and not be topless!
Results.Title: Topless!

Results.ReviewText:
Its a great grill..pricey but worth it!
Lowes assembly and delivered to my Deck! Wow
Good job for a 60 yr old lady unable to do that!
My food is cooking wonderfully. 
The ignite is dependable.. it just looks great.
I bought a cheaper cover from lowes fits fine.
Im really enjoying it!  Happy Grilling!
Results.Title: Love the New Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. We are so sorry to hear you are having an issue with the connection loosening and leaking. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
Nice Grill, I’m a big fan of indirect cooking and even with only 2 burners this works well.
There is 1 really big issue though and that is with the tank holder and gas hookup. As others have stated, it is very difficult to lift the tank high enough to rest on the fuel guage and then the way the tanks are configured you have to turn the tank to hook it onto the fuel guage and this puts stress on the gas to grill connection. This connection has loosened on its own causing leaks. The cabinet needs to be larger or the hose needs to be longer.
Results.Title: Think Twice, poor LPG tank setup

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber grill. Really like them!!
Results.Title: Second Weber Grill ❣️

Results.ReviewText: Great grill one of the best. Relatively easy to assemble. Takes approx. 90 minutes or so. Directions are marginal but atequate. Even cooking heats up and starts up quickly. Only negative is loading tank somehwhat difficult. Starter is somehwhat in the way. Need to be careful not to hit it whe installing tank.
Results.Title: Grilling with the best

Results.ReviewText: Today  we grilled with our new Webber grill ,very impressed food was terrific ..all i can say is if you by a new grill every four years ...purchase a Webber  wont regret...
Results.Title: Should have purchased a Webber years ago

Results.ReviewText: Never going to buy anything else but Weber. This grill is built to last.
Results.Title: Heavy duty with all the features you need.

Results.ReviewText: This my second weber. The first one lasted 23 years And  still worked but would not fit on my deck.
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: great product. just the right size for us. the 2 tables on the side are great that they fold down. burners work great also. i would buy this grill again.
Results.Title: great product

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use, little tricky to assemble but we are very happy with our purchase!
Results.Title: Ahhhhh a new grill

Results.ReviewText: This is an attractive easy to use well made grill. I have had several gas grills and this one seems to be the easiest one to use. The grates are designed for excellent searing and the burner covers help to dispurse the heat without creating hotspots. I love it!
Results.Title: Excellent grill

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
